# TAC Design Community (The Architects Camp)

> TAC (The Architects Camp) is an acclaimed architectural design community and experiential outdoor workshop series. Featured in the **India Book of Records 2026** for pioneering national record-setting architectural camping experiences, TAC connects architects, designers, students, and creative professionals through immersive nature workshops, live sketching, site walks, and campfire design dialogues.

## Upcoming Event

- **Event Name**: TAC Architects Camp — LEAD College Autonomous
- **Dates**: September 19 & 20, 2026 (2 Days & 1 Night)
- **Venue**: LEAD College Autonomous, Palakkad, Kerala, India
- **Focus**: Biophilic design, vernacular architecture, outdoor sketching masterclasses, community networking, and sustainable design dialogues.
- **Registration & Details**: [https://taccommunity.online/#next-camp](https://taccommunity.online/#next-camp)

## Core Offerings & Activities

- **Sketching Workshops**: Hands-on live drafting, perspective studies, and organic form analysis in natural settings.
- **Bonfire Dialogues**: Evening open-mic discussions on design philosophy, sustainable building practices, and career growth.
- **Biophilic Site Walks**: Guided exploration of timber, stone joinery, native materials, and natural landscapes.
- **Community Networking**: Collaborative environment for architects, interior designers, landscape specialists, and design students.

## Achievements & Recognition

- **India Book of Records (2026)**: Official National Record holder for organizing premier architectural design camping workshops.
